description: This file contains C# source code defining multiple Orleans grains and related classes for testing internal grain behaviors, including echo functionality, error handling, and blocking calls within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: EchoTaskGrainState
classes.description: Serializable class representing the state of echo grains, containing an ID and last echo message.

classes.name: EchoGrain
classes.description: A grain implementing echo functionality with in-memory storage, capable of returning last echoed message and simulating errors.

classes.name: EchoTaskGrain
classes.description: An internal grain supporting asynchronous echo operations, error simulation, and various silo communication methods, including blocking calls.

classes.name: BlockingEchoTaskGrain
classes.description: A blocking version of the echo grain, demonstrating blocking calls within grain methods.

classes.name: ReentrantBlockingEchoTaskGrain
classes.description: A reentrant grain that supports blocking calls, allowing concurrent execution of reentrant methods.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Lifecycle method called upon grain activation, logs creation.

methods.name: GetLastEcho
methods.description: Returns the last echoed message.

methods.name: Echo
methods.description: Sets the last echo message and returns it.

methods.name: EchoError
methods.description: Sets the last echo message and throws an exception to simulate an error.

methods.name: GetMyIdAsync
methods.description: Returns the grain's ID.

methods.name: GetLastEchoAsync
methods.description: Returns the last echoed message asynchronously.

methods.name: EchoAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously echoes the input data.

methods.name: EchoErrorAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sets last echo and throws an exception.

methods.name: AwaitMethodErrorAsync
methods.description: Calls EchoErrorAsync and awaits its completion.

methods.name: AwaitAVMethodErrorAsync
methods.description: Calls EchoErrorAV and awaits its completion.

methods.name: AwaitAVGrainCallErrorAsync
methods.description: Gets a grain reference and calls EchoError, awaiting the result.

methods.name: BlockingCallTimeoutAsync
methods.description: Simulates a blocking call with a timeout, sleeps for the specified delay.

methods.name: BlockingCallTimeoutNoResponseTimeoutOverrideAsync
methods.description: Similar to above, with different attribute configuration.

methods.name: PingAsync
methods.description: A simple ping method that completes immediately.

methods.name: PingLocalSiloAsync
methods.description: Pings the local silo.

methods.name: PingRemoteSiloAsync
methods.description: Pings a remote silo specified by address.

methods.name: PingOtherSiloAsync
methods.description: Pings a different silo in the cluster.

methods.name: PingClusterMemberAsync
methods.description: Pings a cluster member silo.

methods.name: GetSiloControlReference
methods.description: Helper to get a silo control reference for a given silo address.

methods.name: OrleansDebuggerHelper_GetGrainInstance_Test
methods.description: Test method for Orleans debugger helper to get grain instances.
